CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010. Converted from writable Date to Formula. Cross-object reference to Quote.ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date__c, where the cascade logic lives. Every quote in the CPQ regression population carried a single distinct Day 1 date across its lines, so deriving the line value from the quote loses no information. Note: as a cross-object formula this field cannot be used as roll-up summary filter criteria.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Day 1 ARR start date, derived from the parent quote.
CustomField.label: Day 1 ARR Start Date
